original_inputs:
Test name:
Checkout Button Positive Test

Hypothesis:
Changing the checkout button text from "Continue" to "Buy Now" will increase purchase conversion rate.

Variant change:
Control uses "Continue".
Variant uses "Buy Now".

Primary metric:
Purchase conversion rate

Control group:
Sample size: 10000
Successful conversions: 1000

Variant group:
Sample size: 10000
Successful conversions: 1200

Test duration:
14 days

Traffic split:
Control: 50%
Variant: 50%

Minimum detectable effect:
1 percentage point

Guardrail information:
Revenue per user was stable.
Page load time was stable.
Customer support contact rate was stable.
No meaningful negative effects were observed.
